requirements.quote:
In the pseudo-code above, cost(n) is a function that returns
         the cost of the path (interior distance) to the address given
         in the NEXT_HOP attribute of the route.
requirements.condition: When evaluating cost(n) in the Phase 2 tie-breaking pseudo-code.
requirements.required_behavior: Return the cost of the path (interior distance) to the address in the route's NEXT_HOP attribute.
requirements.why_checkable: The cost function's destination input and returned interior distance can be checked.

requirements.quote:
f) Remove from consideration all routes other than the route that
         was advertised by the BGP speaker with the lowest BGP
         Identifier value.
requirements.condition: When Phase 2 tie breaking reaches step f with routes still under consideration.
requirements.required_behavior: Remove from consideration all routes other than the route advertised by the BGP speaker with the lowest BGP Identifier value.
requirements.why_checkable: Candidate routes with differing advertising-speaker identifiers expose whether the lowest identifier survives step f.

requirements.quote: g) Prefer the route received from the lowest peer address.
requirements.condition: When Phase 2 tie breaking reaches step g with routes still under consideration.
requirements.required_behavior: Prefer the route received from the lowest peer address.
requirements.why_checkable: Routes remaining tied before step g can be assigned different peer addresses to check the selected route.
